claim: Mail that carries a login or a code is never forwarded unless the person confirms it after being told why.
Mail flagged sensitive is never copied into the knowledge base and never given to a draft as grounding.
Automatic processing never sends mail flagged sensitive to a model; only a request the person makes can.
The person always sees the full original body of their own mail; nothing is redacted from what is stored or shown to them.
Code- and token-shaped text is stripped before a model sees mail the person asks about or a Screener pass reads; automatic routing and workflows refuse it.
Rules decide first; AI only proposes, and the person decides.
A learned habit applies only once it has been earned, and it can be undone.
Nothing leaves that the person did not send, schedule or switch on as an away reply; AI drafts are stored, never sent.
A send goes out once: one Message-ID per send, Sent is checked before any retry, and an unknown outcome is never resent automatically.
The server never opens a mailbox to file mail; it records the folder wanted and the organizer makes the move.
Each account's changes are numbered without gaps and become visible in that order.
Applying the same changes twice, or out of order, leaves a client in the same state.
A change the person makes shows at once and stays unless the server refuses it.
A write that spends either replays a same-key retry or declares why a repeat leaves nothing durable; one that adds a row per call must be keyed.
A write answers X-Sync-Seq, the number /sync delivers it at: the same number on a retry, none when nothing changed.
A desktop install used on its own sends no mail to our servers; its window has no network access.
Erasing a hosted account deletes its mail from the service's database, and no write already under way can bring it back.
What the app says about each plan matches the plan.
Demo and sample mail is invented: no real person's data and no real brand.
No message is ever replaced by a count or a 'more' placeholder.
Views take colour and shadow from the design tokens and match the design reference.
A row of this table counts as bitten only when its verdict records the test red with the deciding line mutated and green restored.
A console error fails the test that caused it.
Self-contained surfaces make no external request; the suite fails any test that tries one.
No test is deleted to make a change pass, and the suite never shrinks unnoticed.
Staff routes never return message content.
The staff database role can read billing and usage, never mail.
The operator console renders no mail.
A metered action cannot run without the credits for it.
Free credits are bounded: one trial and one setup grant per account, and trial starts are throttled per origin.
No plan's allowance costs more than the plan earns.
An account with an unverified address is refused every route that does work, holds a connection or calls a paid service.
Mail in the provider's Junk folder is never imported into ohmail's store; it is read in place, and nothing is moved out of it unless the person asks.
